description: Look up official recalls in the US (default), the UK or Canada. In the US, category 'product' searches CPSC consumer-product recalls by words in the product name (brand plus product type works best, e.g. 'Rowenta vacuum'); 'food_drug' searches FDA food, drug and medical device enforcement reports (e.g. 'CPAP', 'insulin pump'); 'vehicle' searches NHTSA by make, model and model year. With country 'GB' it searches the UK's product recalls and safety reports (OPSS) and Food Standards Agency alerts; with 'CA', Health Canada's recalls (food, health products, medical devices, consumer products); with any EU or EEA country (e.g. 'DE', 'France'), the EU's Safety Gate alerts on dangerous non-food products and vehicles from the last three years. Use this when someone asks if a product, food, medicine or car was recalled, is safe to buy or use, or before they buy something used. An empty result means none was found, not that the item is safe. Not for medical advice.

category.description: product (CPSC), food_drug (FDA food, drugs and medical devices) or vehicle (NHTSA)

country.description: Where the person lives or bought it: United States (default), United Kingdom, Canada or any EU/EEA country

query.description: Product, food, drug or medical device words, for product and food_drug, e.g. 'stroller', 'peanut butter' or 'CPAP'
